title: The Price of Hard Coverage Constraints in Online Conformal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.22646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free uncertainty quantification, but in sequential deployment, standard coverage guarantees can still allow substantial fluctuations in the number of miscoverages over time. We study an online setting in which prediction sets are produced one round at a time and the cumulative number of miscoverages must stay within a prescribed budget throughout deployment.Such a hard coverage guarantee can be enforced by enlarging prediction sets, but how much additional prediction-set size is fundamentally necessary remains unclear. We characterize this unavoidable efficiency cost over $T$ prediction rounds. Remarkably, the cost persists even with i.i.d.\ data, a known score distribution, and perfect knowledge of the population-optimal prediction set. translated_title: 在线共形预测中硬覆盖约束的代价
translated_abstract: 共形预测提供了无分布假设的不确定性量化方法，但在序列化部署中，标准的覆盖率保证仍可能允许误覆盖次数随时间出现大幅波动。我们研究了一种在线设置：预测集逐轮产生，且累积误覆盖次数必须在整个部署过程中保持在规定的预算之内。这种硬覆盖率保证可以通过扩大预测集来强制实现，但从根本上需要多大的额外预测集规模仍不清楚。我们在 $T$ 轮预测中刻画了这种不可避免的效率代价。值得注意的是，即使在数据独立同分布、分数分布已知、以及对总体最优预测集拥有完全了解的理想情况下，这种代价依然存在。在将覆盖率与预测集规模相关联的适当正则性条件下，我们确定了任何在线方法为实现硬覆盖保证所必须付出的最小累积超额预测集规模。
tldr: 本文刻画了在线共形预测中强制硬覆盖约束（累积误覆盖受预算限制）不可避免的最小预测集膨胀代价，并证明即使在数据独立同分布、分数分布已知的最理想情况下，这一代价依然无法避免。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the unavoidable minimum excess prediction-set size required to enforce hard coverage constraints in online conformal prediction, showing this price persists even with i.i.d. data, a known score distribution, and perfect knowledge of the population-optimal prediction set.
